title: Drop Scavenger
description: A mod configure mobs that clear their victims' drops.
body:
### Factors
This mod adds a config file that lets you manage loot-dropping behavior for mob kills.

1. You can put mod ids in a whitelist to let them act as a "Scaveger",which clean any drops from their victims.
2. Or you can put mod ids into the blacklist to protect them from cleanup.
   

### Why This Mod Exists

Many modpacks face a design flaw: Players can exploit neutral/hostile mobs’ AI to farm loot risk-free. This breaks progression and undermines pack balance.

This mod solves that by letting pack authors control which mobs should or shouldn’t drop loot when killed by others.


### ⚠️ WARNING ⚠️

This mod might cause permanent loot loss!

e.g.,to get some vanilla discs needs a creeper killed by skeleton.If skeleton in the whitelist will cause these discs cannot be gained anymore.
